name: session_status
description: Read current stage, task summary, available next actions and already saved results.

name: inspect_task
description: Validate the frozen task and CSV, aggregate technical repeats and expose data quality counts.

name: find_skills
description: Find suitable candidates from the reviewed registry. A missing capability yields a host GitHub discovery request; never silently install.

name: activate_skill
description: Load a reviewed local SKILL.md for this stage. Record a short evidence-based selection reason, not private reasoning.

name: review_evidence
description: Check the preauthorized frozen evidence packet and return source locations and scope. This is NOT a new literature search.

name: calibrate_response
description: Fit the response using the activated calibration skill, then evaluate grouped CV and preset holdout gates. Do not change the model or tolerances.

name: plan_experiments
description: Execute the activated planning skill. Passing models give bounded target/coverage/baseline proposals; failing models give calibration-only proposals.

name: import_results
description: Import only the operator-attached feedback manifest, actual execution log and measured CSV. Freeze/model predictions are not refit first.

name: compare_results
description: Compare new independent samples to concurrent baseline, score the frozen model and report descriptive changes, including null/negative outcomes.

name: prepare_update
description: Export an updated fitting dataset WITHOUT overwriting history. Retire consumed holdout to a separate file and request fresh confirmation data.

name: finish_report
description: Write a static evidence-linked progress report from actual results. Does not invent missing stages or execute experiments.
